react.description:
TabGroup shares selection state between a `Tabs` tablist and a `TabPanels`
placed anywhere in its subtree.

tags.devx:
- Wrap `Tabs` and `TabPanels` in a `TabGroup` to connect them; `Tabs` alone
  (no `TabGroup`) is enough for a navigation-only tab list with no panels.
- Use `selectedTab`/`onSelectedTabChange` for controlled selection, or
  `defaultSelectedTab` (defaults to `0`) when uncontrolled.
tags.a11y:
- Renders no DOM element and no ARIA role itself; the `tablist`/`tab`/
  `tabpanel` roles live on the connected `Tabs`/`Tab`/`TabPanel`.
tags.limitations: - No URL/hash syncing or persistence built in.

className.name: className
className.description: Classes or state-aware element classes applied through the shared style contract.

selectedTab.description: Controlled index of the selected tab.

defaultSelectedTab.name: defaultSelectedTab
defaultSelectedTab.description: Index selected on mount when the group is uncontrolled.

angular.description:
TabGroup shares selection state between a `udx-tabs` tablist and a
`udx-tab-panels` placed anywhere in its subtree.

tags.devx:
- Project `udx-tabs` and `udx-tab-panels`; wrap them in a `udx-tab-group`
  to connect them. `udx-tabs` alone (no group) is enough for a
  navigation-only tab list with no panels.
- Use `selectedTab`/`selectedTabChange` for controlled selection, or
  `defaultSelectedTab` (defaults to `0`) when uncontrolled.
tags.a11y:
- Renders `display: contents` and no ARIA role itself; the `tablist`/
  `tab`/`tabpanel` roles live on the connected `udx-tabs`/`udx-tab`/
  `udx-tab-panel`.
tags.limitations: - No URL/hash syncing or persistence built in.

defaultSelectedTab.description: Index selected on mount when the group is uncontrolled.
